Morgan Stanley met with Washington officials:

- Restrictions would likely start at 3.2T modules made in China (800g/1.6T would be left alone)

- Potential restrictions would likely keep laser market tight (combining US DSPs + lasers could meet the 65% US value threshold per MS)

- Chinese modules could qualify if 65% of bill of materials is US content. Chinese modules using US DSPs and lasers are already near that level

- Analysts expect the positive impact on laser pricing... to be more important than any broad redistribution of transceiver market share.
